question: As of November 9, 2025, who among the following is the Secretary-General of the United Nations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**António Guterres**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **António Manuel de Oliveira Guterres** is a **Portuguese** politician and diplomat who is currently serving as the **9th Secretary-General** of the **United Nations**.
 
• He took office on **1 January 2017**, succeeding **Ban Ki-moon**. As of **November 2025**, he remains in this position, serving his **second term**.
 
• On **18 June 2021**, the **United Nations General Assembly** appointed him for a second term by acclamation, which officially commenced on **1 January 2022** and is set to conclude on **31 December 2026**.
 
• Before his tenure at the **UN**, he served as the **Prime Minister of Portugal** from **1995 to 2002** and was the leader of the **Socialist Party**.
